CollectionFace.description:
One face in an exported collection. On import, faces are matched by identity hash,
then PostScript name, then path and index, so a collection survives re-encoding the
font (TTF to WOFF2) or moving it.

blake3.description: BLAKE3 of the whole file, which differs across containers.

family.description: Typographic family, for a human reading the file.

identity_hash.description: BLAKE3 over the name and outline tables: the first thing import matches on.

index.description: Face index within its file, 0 unless a collection.

path.description: Absolute, or relative to this file when `relative_paths` is set.

postscript_name.description: Name ID 6; the second thing import matches on.

tags.description: Tags carried across with the face.

description: A collection as written by `collection export`; `schemas/collection.json`.

name.description: The collection's name in the index it came from.

relative_paths.description:
True when every `CollectionFace::path` is relative to the directory holding this
file, which is how a bundle is written. Absent means absolute, as every export
before bundles was.

The flag is additive and `SCHEMA_VERSION` does not move for it. An older fontina
reading a bundle ignores it and treats the relative paths as absolute, which
costs nothing in practice: the path is the *last* thing `match_collection_face`
tries, after the identity hash and the PostScript name, and those do not depend
on where the file lives.

schema_version.description: Bumped when a reader could no longer make sense of the file.

title: CollectionExport
